mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing sacubitril metabolite levels; combined effects on vasodilation and serotonergic activity may increase hypotension and serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and serotonergic symptoms; consider dose adjustment or alternative SSRI with lower CYP450 inhibition if hypotension or adverse effects occur.
